Metals (gold, silver, copper, iron, tin, lead), aluminum, steel
Status: Tevila with brocha
Most food-contact metal items.
Glass (Pyrex, Duralex, Corelle, crystal, fiberglass)
Status: Tevila with brocha
Glass is rabbinic; minhag with brocha.
Glazed china, bone china, stoneware, porcelain enamel, CorningWare
Status: Tevila without brocha
—
Teflon/enamel-coated metal, mixed materials (food-contact)
Status: Tevila without brocha
Coating changes brocha status.
Plastic, nylon, rubber, melamine, Formica
Status: Generally no tevila
Some are machmir to tovel without brocha.
Wood
Status: No tevila
—
Stone
Status: No tevila
—
Non-glazed earthenware
Status: No tevila
—
Paper, bone, Styrofoam
Status: No tevila
